classification_basis: Known follows earlier upstream issue, review, or fix coverage. Earlier local-only work does not by itself make an entry Known. Shared mechanisms retain separate AST IDs.

entries.finding: ext2 write faults leave a committed prefix unreported
entries.notes: Reported reproduction: committed bytes survive while EFAULT leaves offset/size behind. Known partial-progress family; ext2 durability consequence retained separately.

entries.finding: ramfs publishes file growth before an empty or zero-progress write
entries.notes: Reported reproduction covers empty writes and zero-progress copy faults. PR #3875 covers only the empty-write subcase.

entries.finding: Vectored file I/O releases the shared offset lock between iovecs
entries.notes: Reported SMP reproduction: concurrent operations interleave within one vector. The GLM rediscovery remained incomplete; the original 01a reproduction supplies the evidence.

entries.finding: Read faults hide copied progress and leave the shared offset unchanged
entries.notes: Reported reproduction: a copied prefix is returned as EFAULT and a retry delivers it again. Known issue #711; retained separately from the ext2 write consequence.

entries.finding: ramfs and exFAT reads modify the user buffer beyond the returned EOF prefix
entries.notes: Reported reproduction changes sentinel bytes beyond the returned count, including a zero-byte EOF read. PR #3778 resulted from the Specula finding.

entries.finding: A failed append advances the shared file offset
entries.notes: Reported zero-progress append fault changes the shared offset. The supplied upstream audit associates the mechanism with the earlier PR #3481; coverage was checked statically.

entries.finding: Pipe readv and writev return EINTR despite SA_RESTART
entries.notes: Reported pipe reproduction fails two restart checks while Linux passes. Earlier PR #3576 covers the restart family; regular-file positional I/O remains latent.

entries.finding: ramfs snapshots the readable length before serializing with resize
entries.notes: Reported resize-race reproduction used userspace timing assistance. The same lock gap was noted in PR #3778 review before the recorded 01b run.

entries.finding: exFAT write preparation becomes stale before data copy and size publication
entries.notes: Original reproduction required a kernel timing hook; later hook-free regression evidence uses another commit. Earlier local work is retained in provenance; no exact upstream report is recorded.

entries.finding: Successful exFAT ftruncate retains the old logical size
entries.notes: Reported deterministic reproduction: ftruncate succeeds while fstat retains the old size. ext2 served as the guest control; no separate Linux run is recorded.

entries.finding: An exFAT regrown hole exposes old backing bytes from the same file
entries.notes: Reported fresh-image reproduction exposes prior bytes from the same file. Cross-file or cross-principal disclosure was not demonstrated.

entries.finding: Empty exFAT writes enlarge EOF and may allocate clusters
entries.notes: Historical reproduction covers buffered I/O. PR #3875 now addresses ramfs/exFAT empty writes; the original metadata predates this upstream association.

entries.finding: exFAT cold-tail extension re-enters an inode write guard and deadlocks
entries.notes: Reported buffered-write deadlock after cold-cache setup. The guest used root to unmount/remount; unprivileged cold-cache setup and direct I/O were not established.

entries.finding: epoll copyout EFAULT loses edge-triggered readiness
entries.notes: Reported maxevents=1 reproduction loses a ready event after failed copyout. Shares the commit-before-copyout mechanism with AST-17; tracked separately.

entries.finding: epoll disables one-shot interest before successful event delivery
entries.notes: Reported maxevents=1 reproduction leaves one-shot interest disabled after failed copyout. Shares the AST-16 mechanism; the challenger rerun was blocked by a dependency fetch.

entries.finding: Final close retains dead epoll interest metadata
entries.notes: Reported fdinfo membership and retained interest after final close. Stale event delivery or retargeting to a reused descriptor was not demonstrated.

entries.finding: Draining a timerfd leaves stale readable state in the poll cache
entries.notes: Reported reproduction covers the timerfd read/drain path through poll. Disarm and epoll extensions remain unexecuted source leads.

entries.finding: A signalfd mask change omits newly eligible readiness
entries.notes: Reported reproduction uses blocked process-directed signals. Exact ordering and surviving output are described in the supplied report.

entries.finding: poll returns timeout without a final readiness scan after timerfd readiness
entries.notes: Source labels REPRODUCED, with an earlier ambiguous review. The decisive ordered marker lacks a retained standalone guest log; timing and provenance qualifications remain open.

entries.finding: signalfd epoll readiness binds to the registering thread
entries.notes: Reported thread-registration reproduction is distinct from the rejected model oracle. Process-directed signals were not shown to fail.

entries.finding: epoll_pwait and pselect6 timeout handling skips deferred pipe readiness
entries.notes: Reported failures on the mask-taking waits; one-vCPU controls cover related waits. Signal-mask restoration was correct.

entries.finding: ext2 direct-write error paths do not wait for all submitted BIOs
entries.notes: MASKED: submitted-I/O mechanism reported, but no late publication or clobbered later write was observed on the tested backends.
